_comment: Example scenario for POST /api/simulate. Every field here is also
exposed as a control in the web UI. Timings are in simulator ticks.

_field_notes.aircraft: tiny | mid | atr72 | a320 | b787 | b777 | a380
_field_notes.gate: front | back | both (both opens two doors and routes each passenger to the nearer one)
_field_notes.arrival: random | queued | groups — how well passengers comply with the called order
_field_notes.luggage_fraction: 0.0..1.0 share of passengers with a carry-on to stow
_field_notes.stow_ticks: ticks to stow a bag in the overhead bin
_field_notes.no_bag_ticks: ticks to sit down without a bag
_field_notes.shuffle_ticks: extra ticks when an already-seated neighbour must stand up
_field_notes.walk_ticks_per_row: ticks to advance one row along the aisle
_field_notes.seed: fixes the manifest, seat assignment and bag draw
_field_notes.strategy: random | back_to_front | wilma | steffen | outside_in | rl
_field_notes.policy: required when strategy is 'rl'; a name from GET /api/policies
